pages.title: Where to find
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Sunken City.

pages.title: How to fight
pages.text: Craft Abyssal Sacrifice and place it in the Altar of Abyss in the Sunken City. A successful summon consumes the offering. Prepare underwater breathing, visibility and a clear swimming route: this is an aquatic fight.

pages.title: What does not work
pages.text: It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat. It checks the boss itself: luring it onto land does not create a helpless target. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory.

pages.title: Drops
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Tidal Claws, Abyssal Egg, Music Disc. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory. In an active campaign this main-boss victory is linked to the Guardian Eye. First record the branch victories: Captain Cornelia, Sea Viper. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory.
